title: Training-free Context-adaptive Attention for Efficient Long Context Modeling
selection_reason: The abstract presents training-free sparse attention with offline sparsity calibration and lightweight online token selection, accelerating prefill and decoding while shrinking KV-cache memory. It reports 2.8× speedup and 61% less cache at 128K context.
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
